concerns.text: Constitution Principle VI (Modality-Agnostic Structural Validation) mandates a 'simulator_validation' subdirectory and a 'simulator_error_rate' metric to validate the text-only simulator against ground truth. This critical validation step is not backed by any Functional Requirement (FR) or Success Criterion (SC) in the spec. FR-001 defines the simulator's output format but lacks the validation logic; SC-001/002/003 focus on reasoning scores, not simulator fidelity. This creates a silent under-specification for a core hypothesis-enabling step.

Constitution Principle VII (Statistical Rigor in Agent Ablation) explicitly requires a script outputting a 'statistical_significance_report.md' with p-values and effect sizes for the ablation study. While FR-005 covers the ablation execution and SC-002 covers the measurement, neither explicitly mandates the generation of this specific report artifact or the inclusion of 'effect sizes' (only p-values are mentioned in SC-003). The requirement to produce a specific report artifact is missing from the FR/SC list.
